description: The reports the user can see, of every type, newest first. Each report's type tells which endpoints work on it: the slides agent, exports, content, datasheets, parameters, templates, duplicating and ownership transfer take SlideDeck reports only, and syncs take the other types only. You can filter by folderId, name and type; when several are set, all must match, and name matching ignores case. Answers up to limit reports, 50 by default and 200 at most, and a nextCursor: pass it as cursor for the next page, until it is null.

cursor.description: Where to continue the list: pass the `nextCursor` returned with the previous page to get the next one. Omit it for the first page.

folderId.description: Only return reports directly in this folder, by its `id` from `listFolders`. Reports in its subfolders aren't included.

limit.description: Maximum number of reports to return on this page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to `50`.

name.description: Only return reports whose name contains this text, ignoring case: `review` matches `Q3 Business Review`.

type.description: Only return reports of this `type`, such as `SlideDeck` for the reports that the slides agent, exports and datasheets work on.

name: listReports
title: List reports
